questions.question: Mughal emperor _______ adopted the title of Alamgir.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Aurangzeb.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The alternative title** "Alamgir"** was adopted by Mughal emperor Aurangzeb which means** 'world conqueror'.**
 
• His original name was "**Muhi-al-Din Muhammad".**
 
• He was the** last of the great Mughal emperors** of India, from **1658 to 1707.**
 
• Aurangzeb was the** third son** of the emperor **Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Maḥal.**
 
• He **conquered Bijapur and Golconda.**
 
• He **discontinued the practice of jarokhadarshan, started by Akbar.**
 
• He began a **policy of destroying Hindu temples.**
 
• He destroyed **Mathura temple and Benares temple.**
 
• **In 1679, he reimposed Jizya and pilgrim tax, which was discontinued by Akbar.**
 
• He was also **against the Sikhs** and** he executed **the ninth Sikh Guru **Teg Bahadur.**
 
• **Aurangazeb is held responsible for the decline of the Mughal emperor due to his policies.**

questions.question: The Channel Tunnel is the name of an undersea tunnel connecting ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. **__France and England.__**

 
• **The Channel Tunnel is an undersea tunnel linking southern England and northern France. **
 
• It is operated by the company Eurotunnel, who also runs a railway shuttle between Folkestone and Calais, carrying passengers in cars, vans and other vehicles.
 
• The Channel is actually comprised of three tunnels: two rail tunnels, used for freight and passenger trains, and a service tunnel.
 
• The idea of a tunnel under the Channel was first proposed in 1802 but construction wasn't started until 1988. It was completed in 1993.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers is NOT a part of the Ganga River System?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e **__Dhansari.__**

 
• The important tributaries of Ganga are the Ramganga, the Gomati, the Ghaghara, the Gandak, the Kosi and the Mahanada.
 
• At Devprayag, the Bhagirathi meets the Alaknanda, then it is known as the Ganga.
 
• The **Yamuna, the westernmost and the longest tributary of the Ganga**, has its source in the Yamunotri glacier, it joins the Ganga at Prayag (Allahabad).
 
• The **Hindon River, being a tributary of the Yamuna** traces its origin from the lower Himalayan ranges housing the Upper Shivalik.
 
• The Kali River, originating in the Doon Valley, is a tributary of the Hindon river.
 
• The **Son is the major right-bank tributary of the Ganga River**. It is a large south bank tributary of the Ganga, originating in the Amarkantak plateau.
 
• **While the River Dhansiri is one of the major south bank tributaries of the river Brahmaputra**

questions.question: The community called Thatheras figures in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, UNESCO for ______.

options.text: Their traditional dance form called Bhangra

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e.__** Manufacturing brass and copper utensils.**__

 
• **The craft of the Thatheras of Jandiala Guru constitutes the traditional technique of manufacturing brass and copper utensils in Punjab.**
 
• The metals used are copper, brass and certain alloys, are believed to be beneficial for health. 
 
• Heating the plates while hammering and curving them into different shapes requires temperature control.
 
• Utensils are manually finished by polishing with traditional materials like sand and tamarind juice.

questions.question: Which of the following organisations publishes an annual report titled Global Competitiveness Index?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__World Economic Forum.__**

 
• The annual Global Competitiveness Index is compiled by the Geneva-based World Economic Forum (WEF).
 
• **About Global Competitiveness Index 2019:**
 
 
• The Global Competitiveness Index ranks 140 nations on the basis of 98 indicators organized into 12 pillars including infrastructure, institution, ICT adoption, macroeconomic stability, health, skills, product market, labour market, financial system, market size, business dynamism, and innovation capability.
 
• This year’s Global Competitiveness Report is the latest edition of the series launched in 1979 that provides an annual assessment of the drivers of productivity and long-term economic growth. 
 
• **Singapore is the world’s most competitive economy in 2019**, overtaking the United States, Hong Kong SAR, Netherlands and Switzerland are the top 5 countries.
 
• **India ranked 68th in the annual Global Competitiveness Index 2019.

 ​**
 
 

**About WEF:**

 
• The World Economic Forum is the International Organization for Public-Private Cooperation.
 
• **It was established in 1971 as a not-for-profit foundation and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. **
 
• The Forum is chaired by Founder and Executive Chairman Professor Klaus Schwab.

questions.question: Who among the following co-authored the book 'Indian Fiscal Federalism' along with YV Reddy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. **__GR Reddy.__**

 
• **The book “Indian Fiscal Federalism” is written by Dr Y. V. Reddy, former Governor of RBI and Chairman of the 14th Finance Commission of India along with Dr G. R. Reddy, Advisor (Finance) to the Government of Telangana**
 
• The book offers a historical perspective on fiscal federalism, in particular, the interplay and overlap of institutional mechanisms. 
 
• It examines the pivotal role of Finance Commissions and assesses momentous events since 2014, such as the replacement of the Planning Commission by NITI Aayog, the emergence of the GST Council, and the controversies surrounding the Fifteenth Finance Commission.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valve of the Heart?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. **__Septum.__**

 
• The heart has four valves - one for each chamber of the heart.
 
• The valves keep blood moving through the heart in the right direction.
 
• The **mitral valve and tricuspid valve** are located between the atria (upper heart chambers) and the ventricles (lower heart chambers).
 
• The **aortic valve and pulmonic valve** are located between the ventricles and the major blood vessels leaving the heart.
 
• **The septum of the heart is the dividing wall between the right and left sides of the heart.**

questions.question: The High Yielding Varieties (HYVs) of wheat were first developed in ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__Mexico.__**

 
• **In Mexico, Prof. Norman Borlaug and his associates developed new varieties of wheat which were early-maturing, highly productive and disease resistant and these varieties were imported and planted in selected regions of India having adequate irrigation facilities. **
 
• It was conclusively demonstrated that the yields from the new varieties exceeded 25 to 100 per cent compared to the yields from traditional varieties.
 
• High Yielding Variety Seeds (HYV seeds) are seeds that are of better quality than normal quality seeds.
 
• The produce from these seeds is a bit more compared to the normal ones.
 
• These seeds are a better option of seeds in order to obtain a healthy and surplus crop.
 
• These seeds have a good immune system to fight with insects and other diseases.

questions.question: Who among the following is also known as the founder of macroeconomics as a separate discipline?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. **__John Maynard Keynes.__**

 
• Macroeconomics is a branch of economics that studies how an overall economy—the market systems that operate on a large scale—behaves.
 
• Macroeconomics studies economy-wide phenomena such as inflation, price levels, rate of economic growth, national income, gross domestic product (GDP), and changes in unemployment.
 
• **Macroeconomics, as it is in its modern form, is often defined as starting with John Maynard Keynes and the publication of his book The General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money in 1936. **

questions.question: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme, announced in the Interim Budget 2019, aims at ________.

options.text: Providing medical insurance for small farmer families
Ensuring minimum income for farmer families who owns cultivable land.
Ensuring effective implementation of minimum support prices for all edible crops
Providing life insurance for small and marginal farmers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e.__** ensuring a minimum income for farmer families who own up to two hectares of cultivable land.**__

 
• Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN):
 
• **Scheme Type:** Central Sector Scheme.
 
• **Ministry:** Ministry of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare.
 
• **Launched Year:** 2019
 
• **Place of Launch:** Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh
 
• **Beneficiaries:** All farmers irrespective of landholding (earlier land up to 2 hectares) are eligible for financial support.
 
• **Financial Support:** 6000 Rs. in three equal instalments of Rs.2000/- each every four months.
 
• Funds will be directly transferred to the bank account of the beneficiaries under the direct benefit scheme.
 
• **Budget allocation:** 20,000 crore for 2018-19, 75,000 crores for 2019-20.

questions.question: The famous Khajurao Group of Monuments was constructed by the ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. **__Chandelas.__**

 
• **Chandela rulers established their religious capital in Khajuraho.**
 
• The Chandelas of Jejakabhukti was a royal dynasty in Central India.
 
• **Nannuka **was the **founder **of **Chandela dynasty** of India.
 
• They ruled much of the Bundelkhand region (then called Jejakabhukti) between the 9th and the 13th centuries.
 
• The Chandelas are well known for their art and architecture, most notably for the temples at their original capital Khajuraho.

questions.question: The Election Commission of India recently launched a mobile app for enabling citizens to report the Model Code of Conduct and Expenditure violations during the elections. The app has been named as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. __**cVigil.**__

 
• **Election Commission has launched a mobile application named ‘cVigil’ for citizens to share proof of malpractices by political parties, their candidates and activists at the time of 17th Loksabha Elections**
 
• The application facilitates the sharing of geo-tagged photographic and video evidence without disclosing the sender’s identity.
 
• The app will be operational only in election-bound states where dates of polling have been announced.
 
• It has inbuilt foolproof location tracking and camera, video recording which will act as evidence collected on the spot.
 
• They can submit this information within seconds without any hassle and physical presence.

questions.question: The 2019 Abel Prize has been awarded to ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. **__Karen Uhlenbeck.__**

 
• Mathematician Karen Uhlenbeck received the 2019 Able Prize in Mathematics.
 
• **Karen Uhlenbeck was the first woman to be awarded the Abel Prize in history.**
 
• The Abel Prize is an annual prize awarded by the King of Norway to excellent mathematicians.
 
• It is named after the famous Norwegian mathematician Niels Henrik Abel.
 
• Karen Uhlenbeck, a professor at the University of Texas won the prize for her pioneering achievements in geometric partial differential equations, gauge theory and integrable systems, and for the fundamental impact of her work on analysis, geometry and mathematical physics.

questions.question: Under the Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) scheme, _______ is being promoted as an alternative transport fuel.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__compressed biogas__**

 
• Union Petroleum Minister launched 'SATAT' initiative to promote **Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG)** as an alternative fuel.
 
• The initiative is aimed at providing a **Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) **as a developmental effort that would benefit both vehicle-users as well as farmers and entrepreneurs.
 
• The use of CBG will also help bring down dependency on crude oil imports.
 
• Shri Dharmendra Pradhan is the Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas & Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
